title: minuartia rupestris subsp. clementei
intro: Minuartia rupestris subsp. clementei, commonly known as alpine rock-cress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the cress family, which is native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of alpine rock-cress are said to include wound healing, immune system modulation, and the inhibition of cancer cell growth, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the exact effects and mechanisms of action of Minuartia rupestris subsp. clementei.
